scenario.name: GB200 NVL72 illustrative chain reconciliation
scenario.notes: NVIDIA product configuration is source-backed. All supply capacity, yield, platform allocation, customer allocation, economics, consensus, and opportunity factors are explicitly synthetic demonstration inputs.

platform.name: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72

accelerator_packages_per_system.methodology: Treats each disclosed Blackwell GPU as one accelerator package for the first-release output metric.
accelerator_packages_per_system.confirming_evidence: A manufacturing BOM or current NVIDIA system specification supports the conversion.
accelerator_packages_per_system.falsifying_evidence: A manufacturing BOM uses a different package or module definition.

servers_per_system.methodology: Treats each of the 18 disclosed compute trays as one server node.
servers_per_system.confirming_evidence: A current NVIDIA BOM or service manual reports the same configuration.
servers_per_system.falsifying_evidence: A current rack specification reports a different compute-node count.

racks_per_system.methodology: The platform system unit is one NVL72 rack.
racks_per_system.confirming_evidence: A current NVIDIA BOM or service manual reports the same configuration.
racks_per_system.falsifying_evidence: The modeled system boundary changes from one rack.

platform.notes: Actual disclosed rack configuration; manufacturing package semantics remain an explicit abstraction.

evidence.title: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 product specifications
evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA reports 36 Grace CPUs, 72 Blackwell GPUs, 13.4 TB HBM3E, and liquid cooling for GB200 NVL72.

evidence.title: NVIDIA DGX GB Rack Scale Systems — Hardware
evidence.excerpt: The guide reports 18 compute trays, 9 NVLink switch trays, 2 TOR switches, 4 ConnectX-7 NICs and 2 BlueField-3 DPUs per tray, eight power shelves, and approximately 120 kW rack consumption.

evidence.title: NVIDIA GB200 NVL Multi-Node Tuning Guide — Grace Blackwell Superchip
evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA describes 72 Blackwell GPUs and two reticle-limited dies per Blackwell GPU on a custom TSMC 4NP process.

evidence.title: Illustrative capacity and yield assumptions
evidence.excerpt: All capacity, yield, and platform-share values linked here are deliberately synthetic.

evidence.title: Illustrative customer allocation assumptions
evidence.excerpt: All customer shares and demand caps linked here are deliberately synthetic.

evidence.title: Illustrative supplier economics assumptions
evidence.excerpt: Revenue per system and gross margin are demonstration inputs, not company guidance or estimates.

evidence.title: Illustrative consensus comparator and opportunity factors
evidence.excerpt: The comparator and ranking factors are synthetic and must not be represented as sell-side consensus.

liquidity.methodology: Illustrative normalized liquidity factor for ranking demonstrations.

timing.methodology: Illustrative timing factor for a next-quarter estimate-revision window.
